comments: This jump-heavy difficulty was substantially underrated at roughly 3.6 stars.
Its large jumps, broad angle diversity, and constant visual search create high reading strain; it felt much closer to 5 stars.
Predictable 180-degree patterns should be only slightly easier than this kind of diverse jump pattern, not treated as a separate low-difficulty category.

milestones.label: broad-region search prototype
milestones.comment: Added substantial reading strain for fast jumps spread across the circle after this map exposed the model's underweighting.

milestones.label: balanced predictable large jumps
milestones.comment: Kept most of the cost on predictable 180-degree jumps and reduced broad regional diversity to a smaller additional premium.
